name: Mistress
source:
The Headmaster’s wife is, if possible, even more intimidating than he is. Beware the moment her tone of voice becomes sweet and girlish. That is when you should RUN. Her relationship with her husband is complicated. Are you about to become one of those ‘complications?’

[From [url=https://pridedrawing.itch.io/bound-to-college]official site[/url]]
